gripOrHq.title: Disgruntled Ice Technician
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. After passing a piece of ice during this run, you may derez that ice and end your run if you broke all the subroutines of that ice.

gripOrHq.title: Streetware Distributor
gripOrHq.rulesText: Take [1] from Streetware Distributor, if it has any bits, at the start of each of your turns. A: Put [3] from the bank on Streetware Distributor.

gripOrHq.title: Panzer Run
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

scoreArea.title: Marked Accounts
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Marked Accounts, give Runner a tag, even if it is not installed. If Marked Accounts is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

root.title: TRAP!
root.rulesText: If you pay [4] when Runner accesses TRAP!, it does 3 Net damage and gives Runner a tag, even if TRAP! is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If TRAP! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.
